map.年终奖个税计算 使用指南: Year-end Bonus Personal Tax Calculation User Guide
map.对比\"单独计税\"与\"并入综合所得\"两种方式，自动推荐更省税方案（全年一次: Compare 'separate taxation' with 'pooled into comprehensive income' and automatically recommend the more tax-saving option (the separate taxation policy for lump-sum annual bonuses runs through 31 December 2027)
map.单独计税: 税 = 年终奖 × 税率r − 速算扣除q（月均奖 = 年终奖 ÷: Separate taxation: tax = year-end bonus × rate r − quick deduction q (bracket set by monthly average = bonus ÷ 12); combined taxation: annual taxable = annual salary × 12 − 60,000 − social insurance − special additional deductions, taxed by the seven-bracket progressive schedule
map.单独计税将年终奖除以12个月确定适用税率与速算扣除数后单独计税；并入综合所得则将: Separate taxation divides the year-end bonus by 12 months to set the rate and quick deduction and taxes it separately; pooling into comprehensive income combines annual salary with the bonus, deducts the 60,000 threshold plus special and special additional deductions, and applies the annual seven-bracket progressive rates. Compute both ways and take the lower tax burden.
map.填写「年度专项扣除（社保公积金等，元）」。: Fill in 'annual special deductions (social insurance, housing fund, CNY)'.
map.发放年终奖前，比较「单独计税」与「并入综合所得计税」两种方式，选择税负更低方案。: Before paying a year-end bonus, compare 'separate taxation' with 'pooled into comprehensive income' and choose the option with the lower tax burden.
map.单独计税下，以全年一次性奖金除以 12 确定适用税率和速算扣除数。: Under separate taxation, the applicable rate and quick deduction are set by dividing the lump-sum annual bonus by 12.
map.注意全年一次性奖金单独计税优惠政策每人每年仅适用一次。: Note that the separate taxation preference for a lump-sum annual bonus may be used only once per person per year.
map.：36000 ÷ 12 = 3000 元，对应税率 3%、速算扣除数 0；个税: : 36000 ÷ 12 = 3000, which gives a 3% rate and quick deduction 0; tax = 36000 × 3% − 0 = 1080, leaving 34,920 received.
map.并入综合所得对比: Comparison with pooling into comprehensive income
map.：若当年综合所得已用满各项扣除、边际税率达 10%，将 36000 并入后可能多: : if that year's comprehensive income has already used all deductions and the marginal rate reaches 10%, pooling the 36,000 may cost 36,000 × 10% − 2520 = 1080 more (the same as separate taxation); at high marginal rates separate taxation is usually cheaper.
map.年终奖单独计税优惠还能用吗？: Can the separate taxation benefit for year-end bonuses still be used?
map.居民个人取得的全年一次性奖金，在政策延续期间可选择单独计税或并入综合所得；具体适: For a lump-sum annual bonus received by a resident individual, during the policy extension period one may choose separate taxation or pooling into comprehensive income; the applicable years follow the latest announcements of the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration.
map.当全年综合所得较低、扣除后应纳税所得为负或很小，并入年终奖可「消化」未用完的免税: When annual comprehensive income is low and taxable income after deductions is negative or very small, pooling the bonus can 'absorb' unused allowances and low bracket rates, which can beat separate taxation.
